MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_RETURN_PATH_START
MAV_CMD.description:
Mission item to specify the start of a failsafe/landing return-path segment (the end of the segment is the next MAV_CMD_DO_LAND_START item).
          A vehicle that is using missions for landing (e.g. in a return mode) will join the mission on the closest path of the return-path segment (instead of MAV_CMD_DO_LAND_START or the nearest waypoint).
          The main use case is to minimize the failsafe flight path in corridor missions, where the inbound/outbound paths are constrained (by geofences) to the same particular path.
          The MAV_CMD_NAV_RETURN_PATH_START would be placed at the start of the return path.
          If a failsafe occurs on the outbound path the vehicle will move to the nearest point on the return path (which is parallel for this kind of mission), effectively turning round and following the shortest path to landing.
          If a failsafe occurs on the inbound path the vehicle is already on the return segment and will continue to landing.
          The Latitude/Longitude/Altitude are optional, and may be set to 0 if not needed.
          If specified, the item defines the waypoint at which the return segment starts.
          If sent using as a command, the vehicle will perform a mission landing (using the land segment if defined) or reject the command if mission landings are not supported, or no mission landing is defined. When used as a command any position information in the command is ignored.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_LAND_START
MAV_CMD.description:
Mission command to perform a landing. This is used as a marker in a mission to tell the autopilot where a sequence of mission items that represents a landing starts.
      It may also be sent via a COMMAND_LONG to trigger a landing, in which case the nearest (geographically) landing sequence in the mission will be used.
      The Latitude/Longitude/Altitude is optional, and may be set to 0 if not needed. If specified then it will be used to help find the closest landing sequence.

MAV_CMD.description: Reposition the vehicle to a specific WGS84 global position. This command is intended for guided commands (for missions use MAV_CMD_NAV_WAYPOINT instead).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_PAUSE_CONTINUE
MAV_CMD.description: If in a GPS controlled position mode, hold the current position or continue.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_REVERSE
MAV_CMD.description: Set moving direction to forward or reverse.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI_LOCATION
MAV_CMD.description: Sets the region of interest (ROI) to a location. This can then be used by the vehicle's control system to control the vehicle attitude and the attitude of various sensors such as cameras.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI_WPNEXT_OFFSET
MAV_CMD.description: Sets the region of interest (ROI) to be toward next waypoint, with optional pitch/roll/yaw offset. This can then be used by the vehicle's control system to control the vehicle attitude and the attitude of various sensors such as cameras.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI_NONE
MAV_CMD.description: Cancels any previous ROI command returning the vehicle/sensors to default flight characteristics. This can then be used by the vehicle's control system to control the vehicle attitude and the attitude of various sensors such as cameras.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI_SYSID
MAV_CMD.description: Mount tracks system with specified system ID. Determination of target vehicle position may be done with GLOBAL_POSITION_INT or any other means.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_CONTROL_VIDEO
MAV_CMD.description: Control onboard camera system.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI
MAV_CMD.description: Sets the region of interest (ROI) for a sensor set or the vehicle itself. This can then be used by the vehicle's control system to control the vehicle attitude and the attitude of various sensors such as cameras.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_DIGICAM_CONFIGURE
MAV_CMD.description: Configure digital camera. This is a fallback message for systems that have not yet implemented PARAM_EXT_XXX messages and camera definition files (see https://mavlink.io/en/services/camera_def.html ).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_DIGICAM_CONTROL
MAV_CMD.description: Control digital camera. This is a fallback message for systems that have not yet implemented PARAM_EXT_XXX messages and camera definition files (see https://mavlink.io/en/services/camera_def.html ).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONFIGURE
MAV_CMD.description: Mission command to configure a camera or antenna mount

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONTROL
MAV_CMD.description: Mission command to control a camera or antenna mount

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST
MAV_CMD.description: Mission command to set camera trigger distance for this flight. The camera is triggered each time this distance is exceeded. This command can also be used to set the shutter integration time for the camera.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_FENCE_ENABLE
MAV_CMD.description:
Enable the geofence.
          This can be used in a mission or via the command protocol.
          The persistence/lifetime of the setting is undefined.
          Depending on flight stack implementation it may persist until superseded, or it may revert to a system default at the end of a mission.
          Flight stacks typically reset the setting to system defaults on reboot.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_PARACHUTE
MAV_CMD.description: Mission item/command to release a parachute or enable/disable auto release.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_MOTOR_TEST
MAV_CMD.description: Mission command to perform motor test.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_INVERTED_FLIGHT
MAV_CMD.description: Change to/from inverted flight.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_GRIPPER
MAV_CMD.description: Mission command to operate a gripper.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_AUTOTUNE_ENABLE
MAV_CMD.description: Enable/disable autotune.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_NAV_SET_YAW_SPEED
MAV_CMD.description: Sets a desired vehicle turn angle and speed change.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_INTERVAL
MAV_CMD.description: Mission command to set camera trigger interval for this flight. If triggering is enabled, the camera is triggered each time this interval expires. This command can also be used to set the shutter integration time for the camera.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONTROL_QUAT
MAV_CMD.description: Mission command to control a camera or antenna mount, using a quaternion as reference.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_GUIDED_MASTER
MAV_CMD.description: set id of master controller

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_GUIDED_LIMITS
MAV_CMD.description: Set limits for external control

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_ENGINE_CONTROL
MAV_CMD.description: Control vehicle engine. This is interpreted by the vehicles engine controller to change the target engine state. It is intended for vehicles with internal combustion engines

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_MISSION_CURRENT
MAV_CMD.description: Set the mission item with sequence number seq as current item. This means that the MAV will continue to this mission item on the shortest path (not following the mission items in-between).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_LAST
MAV_CMD.description: NOP - This command is only used to mark the upper limit of the DO commands in the enumeration

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_CALIBRATION
MAV_CMD.description: Trigger calibration. This command will be only accepted if in pre-flight mode. Except for Temperature Calibration, only one sensor should be set in a single message and all others should be zero.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_SET_SENSOR_OFFSETS
MAV_CMD.description: Set sensor offsets. This command will be only accepted if in pre-flight mode.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_UAVCAN
MAV_CMD.description: Trigger UAVCAN configuration (actuator ID assignment and direction mapping). Note that this maps to the legacy UAVCAN v0 function UAVCAN_ENUMERATE, which is intended to be executed just once during initial vehicle configuration (it is not a normal pre-flight command and has been poorly named).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_STORAGE
MAV_CMD.description: Request storage of different parameter values and logs. This command will be only accepted if in pre-flight mode.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_REBOOT_SHUTDOWN
MAV_CMD.description: Request the reboot or shutdown of system components.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_OVERRIDE_GOTO
MAV_CMD.description: Override current mission with command to pause mission, pause mission and move to position, continue/resume mission. When param 1 indicates that the mission is paused (MAV_GOTO_DO_HOLD), param 2 defines whether it holds in place or moves to another position.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_OBLIQUE_SURVEY
MAV_CMD.description: Mission command to set a Camera Auto Mount Pivoting Oblique Survey (Replaces CAM_TRIGG_DIST for this purpose). The camera is triggered each time this distance is exceeded, then the mount moves to the next position. Params 4~6 set-up the angle limits and number of positions for oblique survey, where mount-enabled vehicles automatically roll the camera between shots to emulate an oblique camera setup (providing an increased HFOV). This command can also be used to set the shutter integration time for the camera.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_MISSION_START
MAV_CMD.description: start running a mission

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_COMPONENT_ARM_DISARM
MAV_CMD.description: Arms / Disarms a component

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_RUN_PREARM_CHECKS
MAV_CMD.description: Instructs system to run pre-arm checks.  This command should return MAV_RESULT_TEMPORARILY_REJECTED in the case the system is armed, otherwise MAV_RESULT_ACCEPTED.  Note that the return value from executing this command does not indicate whether the vehicle is armable or not, just whether the system has successfully run/is currently running the checks.  The result of the checks is reflected in the SYS_STATUS message.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_GET_HOME_POSITION
MAV_CMD.description: Request the home position from the vehicle.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_START_RX_PAIR
MAV_CMD.description: Starts receiver pairing.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_GET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL
MAV_CMD.description: Request the interval between messages for a particular MAVLink message ID. The receiver should ACK the command and then emit its response in a MESSAGE_INTERVAL message.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL
MAV_CMD.description: Set the interval between messages for a particular MAVLink message ID. This interface replaces REQUEST_DATA_STREAM.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE
MAV_CMD.description: Request the target system(s) emit a single instance of a specified message (i.e. a "one-shot" version of MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION
MAV_CMD.description: Request MAVLink protocol version compatibility. All receivers should ACK the command and then emit their capabilities in an PROTOCOL_VERSION message

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_AUTOPILOT_CAPABILITIES
MAV_CMD.description: Request autopilot capabilities. The receiver should ACK the command and then emit its capabilities in an AUTOPILOT_VERSION message

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_CAMERA_INFORMATION
MAV_CMD.description: Request camera information (CAMERA_INFORMATION).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_CAMERA_SETTINGS
MAV_CMD.description: Request camera settings (CAMERA_SETTINGS).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_STORAGE_INFORMATION
MAV_CMD.description: Request storage information (STORAGE_INFORMATION). Use the command's target_component to target a specific component's storage.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_STORAGE_FORMAT
MAV_CMD.description: Format a storage medium. Once format is complete, a STORAGE_INFORMATION message is sent. Use the command's target_component to target a specific component's storage.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_CAMERA_CAPTURE_STATUS
MAV_CMD.description: Request camera capture status (CAMERA_CAPTURE_STATUS)

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_FLIGHT_INFORMATION
MAV_CMD.description: Request flight information (FLIGHT_INFORMATION)

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_RESET_CAMERA_SETTINGS
MAV_CMD.description: Reset all camera settings to Factory Default

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SET_CAMERA_MODE
MAV_CMD.description: Set camera running mode. Use NaN for reserved values. GCS will send a MAV_CMD_REQUEST_VIDEO_STREAM_STATUS command after a mode change if the camera supports video streaming.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SET_CAMERA_ZOOM
MAV_CMD.description: Set camera zoom. Camera must respond with a CAMERA_SETTINGS message (on success).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SET_CAMERA_FOCUS
MAV_CMD.description: Set camera focus. Camera must respond with a CAMERA_SETTINGS message (on success).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SET_STORAGE_USAGE
MAV_CMD.description:
Set that a particular storage is the preferred location for saving photos, videos, and/or other media (e.g. to set that an SD card is used for storing videos).
          There can only be one preferred save location for each particular media type: setting a media usage flag will clear/reset that same flag if set on any other storage.
          If no flag is set the system should use its default storage.
          A target system can choose to always use default storage, in which case it should ACK the command with MAV_RESULT_UNSUPPORTED.
          A target system can choose to not allow a particular storage to be set as preferred storage, in which case it should ACK the command with MAV_RESULT_DENIED.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SET_CAMERA_SOURCE
MAV_CMD.description: Set camera source. Changes the camera's active sources on cameras with multiple image sensors.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_JUMP_TAG
MAV_CMD.description: Tagged jump target. Can be jumped to with MAV_CMD_DO_JUMP_TAG.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_JUMP_TAG
MAV_CMD.description: Jump to the matching tag in the mission list. Repeat this action for the specified number of times. A mission should contain a single matching tag for each jump. If this is not the case then a jump to a missing tag should complete the mission, and a jump where there are multiple matching tags should always select the one with the lowest mission sequence number.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_PITCHYAW
MAV_CMD.description: Set gimbal manager pitch/yaw setpoints (low rate command). It is possible to set combinations of the values below. E.g. an angle as well as a desired angular rate can be used to get to this angle at a certain angular rate, or an angular rate only will result in continuous turning. NaN is to be used to signal unset. Note: only the gimbal manager will react to this command - it will be ignored by a gimbal device. Use GIMBAL_MANAGER_SET_PITCHYAW if you need to stream pitch/yaw setpoints at higher rate.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_CONFIGURE
MAV_CMD.description: Gimbal configuration to set which sysid/compid is in primary and secondary control.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_IMAGE_START_CAPTURE
MAV_CMD.description:
Start image capture sequence. CAMERA_IMAGE_CAPTURED must be emitted after each capture.

          Param1 (id) may be used to specify the target camera: 0: all cameras, 1 to 6: autopilot-connected cameras, 7-255: MAVLink camera component ID.
          It is needed in order to target specific cameras connected to the autopilot, or specific sensors in a multi-sensor camera (neither of which have a distinct MAVLink component ID).
          It is also needed to specify the target camera in missions.

          When used in a mission, an autopilot should execute the MAV_CMD for a specified local camera (param1 = 1-6), or resend it as a command if it is intended for a MAVLink camera (param1 = 7 - 255), setting the command's target_component as the param1 value (and setting param1 in the command to zero).
          If the param1 is 0 the autopilot should do both.

          When sent in a command the target MAVLink address is set using target_component.
          If addressed specifically to an autopilot: param1 should be used in the same way as it is for missions (though command should NACK with MAV_RESULT_DENIED if a specified local camera does not exist).
          If addressed to a MAVLink camera, param 1 can be used to address all cameras (0), or to separately address 1 to 7 individual sensors. Other values should be NACKed with MAV_RESULT_DENIED.
          If the command is broadcast (target_component is 0) then param 1 should be set to 0 (any other value should be NACKED with MAV_RESULT_DENIED). An autopilot would trigger any local cameras and forward the command to all channels.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_IMAGE_STOP_CAPTURE
MAV_CMD.description:
Stop image capture sequence.

          Param1 (id) may be used to specify the target camera: 0: all cameras, 1 to 6: autopilot-connected cameras, 7-255: MAVLink camera component ID.
          It is needed in order to target specific cameras connected to the autopilot, or specific sensors in a multi-sensor camera (neither of which have a distinct MAVLink component ID).
          It is also needed to specify the target camera in missions.

          When used in a mission, an autopilot should execute the MAV_CMD for a specified local camera (param1 = 1-6), or resend it as a command if it is intended for a MAVLink camera (param1 = 7 - 255), setting the command's target_component as the param1 value (and setting param1 in the command to zero).
          If the param1 is 0 the autopilot should do both.

          When sent in a command the target MAVLink address is set using target_component.
          If addressed specifically to an autopilot: param1 should be used in the same way as it is for missions (though command should NACK with MAV_RESULT_DENIED if a specified local camera does not exist).
          If addressed to a MAVLink camera, param1 can be used to address all cameras (0), or to separately address 1 to 7 individual sensors. Other values should be NACKed with MAV_RESULT_DENIED.
          If the command is broadcast (target_component is 0) then param 1 should be set to 0 (any other value should be NACKED with MAV_RESULT_DENIED). An autopilot would trigger any local cameras and forward the command to all channels.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_TRIGGER_CONTROL
MAV_CMD.description: Enable or disable on-board camera triggering system.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_CAMERA_TRACK_POINT
MAV_CMD.description: If the camera supports point visual tracking (CAMERA_CAP_FLAGS_HAS_TRACKING_POINT is set), this command allows to initiate the tracking.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_CAMERA_TRACK_RECTANGLE
MAV_CMD.description: If the camera supports rectangle visual tracking (CAMERA_CAP_FLAGS_HAS_TRACKING_RECTANGLE is set), this command allows to initiate the tracking.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_CAMERA_STOP_TRACKING
MAV_CMD.description: Stops ongoing tracking.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_VIDEO_START_CAPTURE
MAV_CMD.description: Starts video capture (recording).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_VIDEO_STOP_CAPTURE
MAV_CMD.description: Stop the current video capture (recording).

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_VIDEO_START_STREAMING
MAV_CMD.description: Start video streaming

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_VIDEO_STOP_STREAMING
MAV_CMD.description: Stop the given video stream

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_VIDEO_STREAM_INFORMATION
MAV_CMD.description: Request video stream information (VIDEO_STREAM_INFORMATION)

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_REQUEST_VIDEO_STREAM_STATUS
MAV_CMD.description: Request video stream status (VIDEO_STREAM_STATUS)

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_LOGGING_START
MAV_CMD.description: Request to start streaming logging data over MAVLink (see also LOGGING_DATA message)

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_LOGGING_STOP
MAV_CMD.description: Request to stop streaming log data over MAVLink

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_CONTROL_HIGH_LATENCY
MAV_CMD.description: Request to start/stop transmitting over the high latency telemetry

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_PANORAMA_CREATE
MAV_CMD.description: Create a panorama at the current position

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_VTOL_TRANSITION
MAV_CMD.description: Request VTOL transition

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_ARM_AUTHORIZATION_REQUEST
MAV_CMD.description: Request authorization to arm the vehicle to a external entity, the arm authorizer is responsible to request all data that is needs from the vehicle before authorize or deny the request. If approved the progress of command_ack message should be set with period of time that this authorization is valid in seconds or in case it was denied it should be set with one of the reasons in ARM_AUTH_DENIED_REASON.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SET_GUIDED_SUBMODE_STANDARD
MAV_CMD.description: This command sets the submode to standard guided when vehicle is in guided mode. The vehicle holds position and altitude and the user can input the desired velocities along all three axes.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SET_GUIDED_SUBMODE_CIRCLE
MAV_CMD.description: This command sets submode circle when vehicle is in guided mode. Vehicle flies along a circle facing the center of the circle. The user can input the velocity along the circle and change the radius. If no input is given the vehicle will hold position.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_RETURN_POINT
MAV_CMD.description: Fence return point (there can only be one such point in a geofence definition). If rally points are supported they should be used instead.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_POLYGON_VERTEX_INCLUSION
MAV_CMD.description: Fence vertex for an inclusion polygon (the polygon must not be self-intersecting). The vehicle must stay within this area. Minimum of 3 vertices required.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_POLYGON_VERTEX_EXCLUSION
MAV_CMD.description: Fence vertex for an exclusion polygon (the polygon must not be self-intersecting). The vehicle must stay outside this area. Minimum of 3 vertices required.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_CIRCLE_INCLUSION
MAV_CMD.description: Circular fence area. The vehicle must stay inside this area.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_CIRCLE_EXCLUSION
MAV_CMD.description: Circular fence area. The vehicle must stay outside this area.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_NAV_RALLY_POINT
MAV_CMD.description: Rally point. You can have multiple rally points defined.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_UAVCAN_GET_NODE_INFO
MAV_CMD.description: Commands the vehicle to respond with a sequence of messages UAVCAN_NODE_INFO, one message per every UAVCAN node that is online. Note that some of the response messages can be lost, which the receiver can detect easily by checking whether every received UAVCAN_NODE_STATUS has a matching message UAVCAN_NODE_INFO received earlier; if not, this command should be sent again in order to request re-transmission of the node information messages.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SAFETY_SWITCH_STATE
MAV_CMD.description: Change state of safety switch.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_ADSB_OUT_IDENT
MAV_CMD.description: Trigger the start of an ADSB-out IDENT. This should only be used when requested to do so by an Air Traffic Controller in controlled airspace. This starts the IDENT which is then typically held for 18 seconds by the hardware per the Mode A, C, and S transponder spec.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_PAYLOAD_PREPARE_DEPLOY
MAV_CMD.description: Deploy payload on a Lat / Lon / Alt position. This includes the navigation to reach the required release position and velocity.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_PAYLOAD_CONTROL_DEPLOY
MAV_CMD.description: Control the payload deployment.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_WAYPOINT_USER_1
MAV_CMD.description: User defined waypoint item. Ground Station will show the Vehicle as flying through this item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_WAYPOINT_USER_2
MAV_CMD.description: User defined waypoint item. Ground Station will show the Vehicle as flying through this item.

MAV_CMD.description: User defined waypoint item. Ground Station will show the Vehicle as flying through this item.

MAV_CMD.description: User defined waypoint item. Ground Station will show the Vehicle as flying through this item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_WAYPOINT_USER_5
MAV_CMD.description: User defined waypoint item. Ground Station will show the Vehicle as flying through this item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SPATIAL_USER_1
MAV_CMD.description: User defined spatial item. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: ROI item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SPATIAL_USER_2
MAV_CMD.description: User defined spatial item. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: ROI item.

MAV_CMD.description: User defined spatial item. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: ROI item.

MAV_CMD.description: User defined spatial item. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: ROI item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_SPATIAL_USER_5
MAV_CMD.description: User defined spatial item. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: ROI item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_USER_1
MAV_CMD.description: User defined command. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_PARAMETER item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_USER_2
MAV_CMD.description: User defined command. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_PARAMETER item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_USER_3
MAV_CMD.description: User defined command. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_PARAMETER item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_USER_4
MAV_CMD.description: User defined command. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_PARAMETER item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_USER_5
MAV_CMD.description: User defined command. Ground Station will not show the Vehicle as flying through this item. Example: MAV_CMD_DO_SET_PARAMETER item.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_CAN_FORWARD
MAV_CMD.description: Request forwarding of CAN packets from the given CAN bus to this interface. CAN Frames are sent using CAN_FRAME and CANFD_FRAME messages

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_FIXED_MAG_CAL_YAW
MAV_CMD.description: Magnetometer calibration based on provided known yaw. This allows for fast calibration using WMM field tables in the vehicle, given only the known yaw of the vehicle. If Latitude and longitude are both zero then use the current vehicle location.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_DO_WINCH
MAV_CMD.description: Command to operate winch.

MAV_CMD.name: MAV_CMD_EXTERNAL_POSITION_ESTIMATE
MAV_CMD.description: Provide an external position estimate for use when dead-reckoning. This is meant to be used for occasional position resets that may be provided by a external system such as a remote pilot using landmarks over a video link.

MAV_ROI.name: MAV_ROI_WPNEXT
MAV_ROI.description: Point toward next waypoint, with optional pitch/roll/yaw offset.

MAV_RESULT.name: MAV_RESULT_ACCEPTED
MAV_RESULT.description: Command is valid (is supported and has valid parameters), and was executed.

MAV_RESULT.name: MAV_RESULT_TEMPORARILY_REJECTED
MAV_RESULT.description: Command is valid, but cannot be executed at this time. This is used to indicate a problem that should be fixed just by waiting (e.g. a state machine is busy, can't arm because have not got GPS lock, etc.). Retrying later should work.

MAV_RESULT.name: MAV_RESULT_DENIED
MAV_RESULT.description: Command is invalid (is supported but has invalid parameters). Retrying same command and parameters will not work.

MAV_RESULT.name: MAV_RESULT_FAILED
MAV_RESULT.description: Command is valid, but execution has failed. This is used to indicate any non-temporary or unexpected problem, i.e. any problem that must be fixed before the command can succeed/be retried. For example, attempting to write a file when out of memory, attempting to arm when sensors are not calibrated, etc.

MAV_RESULT.name: MAV_RESULT_IN_PROGRESS
MAV_RESULT.description: Command is valid and is being executed. This will be followed by further progress updates, i.e. the component may send further COMMAND_ACK messages with result MAV_RESULT_IN_PROGRESS (at a rate decided by the implementation), and must terminate by sending a COMMAND_ACK message with final result of the operation. The COMMAND_ACK.progress field can be used to indicate the progress of the operation. There is no need for the sender to retry the command, but if done during execution, the component will return MAV_RESULT_IN_PROGRESS with an updated progress.

MAV_RESULT.name: MAV_RESULT_COMMAND_LONG_ONLY
MAV_RESULT.description: Command is only accepted when sent as a COMMAND_LONG.

MAV_RESULT.name: MAV_RESULT_COMMAND_INT_ONLY
MAV_RESULT.description: Command is only accepted when sent as a COMMAND_INT.

MAV_MISSION_RESULT.name: MAV_MISSION_ERROR
MAV_MISSION_RESULT.description: Generic error / not accepting mission commands at all right now.

MAV_MISSION_RESULT.name: MAV_MISSION_INVALID
MAV_MISSION_RESULT.description: One of the parameters has an invalid value.

MAV_MISSION_RESULT.name: MAV_MISSION_INVALID_PARAM5_X
MAV_MISSION_RESULT.description: x / param5 has an invalid value.

MAV_MISSION_RESULT.name: MAV_MISSION_INVALID_PARAM6_Y
MAV_MISSION_RESULT.description: y / param6 has an invalid value.

MAV_MISSION_RESULT.name: MAV_MISSION_INVALID_PARAM7
MAV_MISSION_RESULT.description: z / param7 has an invalid value.

MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.name: MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY_SET_POSITION_TARGET_GLOBAL_INT
MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.description: Autopilot supports commanding position and velocity targets in global scaled integers.

MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.description: Autopilot supports terrain protocol / data handling.

MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.name: MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY_RESERVED3
MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.description: Reserved for future use.

MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.description: Autopilot supports the MAV_CMD_DO_FLIGHTTERMINATION command (flight termination).

MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.description: Autopilot supports onboard compass calibration.

MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.description: Autopilot supports MAVLink version 2.

MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.description: Autopilot supports mission fence protocol.

MAV_PROTOCOL_CAPABILITY.description: Reserved for future use.

MAV_BATTERY_CHARGE_STATE.description: Battery state is critical, return or abort immediately.

MAV_BATTERY_CHARGE_STATE.description: Battery state is too low for ordinary abort sequence. Perform fastest possible emergency stop to prevent damage.

MAV_BATTERY_CHARGE_STATE.description: Battery is diagnosed to be defective or an error occurred, usage is discouraged / prohibited. Possible causes (faults) are listed in MAV_BATTERY_FAULT.

MAV_BATTERY_MODE.description: Battery mode not supported/unknown battery mode/normal operation.

MAV_BATTERY_FAULT.description: Battery firmware is not compatible with current autopilot firmware.

MAV_GENERATOR_STATUS_FLAG.description: Power electronic or generator cooling system error.

MAV_GENERATOR_STATUS_FLAG.description: Generator controller power rail experienced a fault.

MAV_GENERATOR_STATUS_FLAG.description: Generator controller exceeded the overcurrent threshold and shutdown to prevent damage.
